verdict.rationale: Temporal ships a CLI-based local development service and a dedicated test server (with time-skipping) explicitly for running end-to-end/integration tests without needing a production Temporal Service, effectively providing a sandbox for testing workflows and activities. This directly supports testing without touching production data, though the evidence doesn't explicitly discuss data isolation or seeding sandbox data. missing for 10: explicit documentation on production-data isolation/mocking, independent hands-on confirmation of sandbox fidelity, and any data-masking or synthetic-data tooling.
